hooks.command: aq announce -c "${AQ_CONJECTURE:-C-0}" --claim "editing" --phase proof -f "$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_PARAMS | jq -r '.file_path // .file_name' 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')" --status prosecuting 2>/dev/null || true

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_PARAMS" | grep -q 'git commit'; then REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); CONJECTURE=${AQ_CONJECTURE:-C-0}; FILES=$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD 2>/dev/null | paste -sd, -); CLAIM=$(git log --format=%s -1 HEAD 2>/dev/null | head -c80); aq announce -c "$CONJECTURE" --claim "$CLAIM" --phase proof -f "$FILES" --status done 2>/dev/null; "${REPO_ROOT}/bin/aq-fanout.sh" "$CONJECTURE" proof "$FILES" "$CLAIM" 2>/dev/null; fi || true
